lines.text: Moabites and Ammonites come to make war on Jehoshaphat, so he seeks the LORD and proclaims a fast throughout Judah.
Jehoshaphat prays in the house of the LORD, reminding God that He gave the land forever to the descendants of Abraham.
The Spirit of the LORD comes on Jahaziel, a Levite, who says the battle belongs to God and Judah should stand firm.
Early in the morning Judah leaves for the Wilderness of Sinai, and the LORD sets ambushes against the enemy when the singers begin praising.
Jehoshaphat allies with Ahaziah king of Israel and builds ships at Joppa, but the ships are wrecked and never sail to Tarshish.
